comments.value: I'm sad this wasn't already whitelisted. This is the feature I've anticipated most since the update announcement. PLEASE allow it!

We're aware of this feature and are also quite excited to get it into VRChat, but it needs a pretty hefty security review, especially if we plan on putting it on avatars. We've also got to ensure it doesn't step on the toes of our various systems-- we need to test it, a lot.

In short, planned status? Soon™? But we're not on it just yet because we're trying to get the whole 2017 upgrade sorted out before we work in new features.
this should definitely be a thing!

details:
Unity 2017 has some great new features for animators like my self.
Most of all the Timeline feature.
In short the unity time line allows you to:
*create, play, and edit multiple animations on multiple characters and objects at the same time.
*edit audio clips together for your sequence.
*make more complex particle effects.

Basically Timeline is just like the timeline in a video editing software, but instead of editing audio and video your editing audio and animations.

This is a really powerful tool for people who like to make big animations on there avatars and/or maps.
And this feature would make the lives of many content creators so much easier.

I believe the addition of this wonderful feature to vrchat will open the door for many more content creators to start making these big beautiful animations.

https://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/TimelineOverview.html

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G_uBFM3YUF4
